column3: MT 2:8. Close to the Hebrew; “open regions” is rendered “towns without walls.”
MT 2:10. Close to the Hebrew; “alas! alas!” is rendered “Up, up!”, and “I have scattered you” “I have spread you abroad.”
MT 2:11. Close to the Hebrew; “alas!” is rendered “Up,” and “inhabitant of the daughter of Babylon” “you who dwell with the daughter of Babylon.”
MT 2:12. Close to the Hebrew; “after glory he has sent me” is rendered “He sent Me after glory,” and “his eye” “His eye,” capitalized.
MT 2:13. Close to the Hebrew; “brandish” is rendered “shake,” and “their slaves” “their servants.”
MT 2:14. Close to the Hebrew; “shout for joy” is rendered “Sing.”
MT 2:16. Close to the Hebrew; “the land of holiness” is rendered “the Holy Land,” and “will inherit Judah [as] his portion” “will take possession of Judah as His inheritance.”
